newsitem.title: USA: Trinity Palmira 1 well exceeds expectation.
newsitem.headline: Trinity Palmira 1 well exceeds expectation.

text.p: Trinity Gas Corp said Thursday its first well in Colombia, the Palmira 1 well, exceeded its expectations.
The company said data from Palmira 1 indicate the field's reserves will approximate six trillion cubic feet of natural gas.
The company also said technical and engineering information continues to be processed and will be released Friday or next week.
In addition, the company said its drilling operations are now moving to the Manuelita 1 site, also in the San Jose Hacienda. Drilling there is scheduled to begin early in August.

The company also said officials from the largest gas distribution company in Colombia have expressed interest in signing a contract to construct a gas distribution system in the Cauca Valley. It declined to name the company.

Trinity said that firm has also offered to buy all the natural gas that it can produce and also would finance electric generating plants if it produced natural gas in the quantities indicated by Palmira 1.
